NOTES.OPEN_EMPTY_STAFF: The teacher hasn't added an assessment under "{{names}}" yet, so no student gets a total.
NOTES.GRADES_CLOSED: Marks and their history can be viewed, but not changed until the administration opens them.
NOTES.GRADES_CLOSED_ADMIN: Marks and their history can be viewed, but not changed. You can open them from Settings → Academic Years and Terms.

TABLE.FIXED_COMPONENT: Fixed component of the subject plan
TABLE.TOTAL_AFTER_SAVE: The total updates after you save the sheet

CELL.RANGE_ERROR: Enter a number from 0 to {{max}} (2 decimals at most)
CELL.CLEAR_ERROR: A saved mark can't be removed, only changed

LEGEND.FIXED: Fixed component of the subject plan
LEGEND.MISSING: No mark yet (not counted as zero)
LEGEND.EDITED: Changed after it was entered (click a mark's icon to see its history)

HISTORY.EDITED: Changed after it was entered: click to see the history

HISTORY.TITLE: Mark history
HISTORY.NEVER_CHANGED: Not changed since it was entered

SAVE_BAR.INVALID: Marks that are not valid: {{count}} (fix them before saving)
SAVE_BAR.HINT: The totals and results update after saving.
SAVE_BAR.VISIBLE: Saved marks are visible to the student and their parents right away.

SAVE.TOO_MANY: You can't save more than {{max}} marks at once. Save some of them first.

LEAVE.TITLE: Leave without saving?
LEAVE.MESSAGE: You have {{count}} changed marks that are not saved. If you leave this page, these changes are lost.

HEADER.TITLE: Student Rollover
HEADER.SUBTITLE: Move the students of an earlier term into the current term, and check what happens to each student before running it.

STATE.NO_CURRENT_TERM: There is no current term yet. Set the current term first, then roll the students into it.
STATE.NO_SOURCE: There is no term before the current term to roll students from.

ROUTE.LABEL: From and to
ROUTE.FROM_HINT: The term just before the current term is chosen by default
ROUTE.NEW_YEAR: New year: promote, repeat and graduate
ROUTE.SAME_YEAR: Same year: same class and section

THRESHOLD.LABEL: Repeat suggestion rule
THRESHOLD.RULE_START: "Repeat" is suggested for students who failed
THRESHOLD.HINT: A suggestion only: you can still change any student's decision. From {{min}} to {{max}}.
THRESHOLD.RANGE_ERROR: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.

DIALOG.TITLE: Changing the rule resets the decisions
DIALOG.MESSAGE_ONE: You changed one student's decision by hand. After saving, the preview reloads and every decision goes back to its new suggestion.
DIALOG.MESSAGE_MANY: You changed {{count}} students' decisions by hand. After saving, the preview reloads and every decision goes back to its new suggestion.

PREVIEW.EMPTY: There are no active students in this term.
PREVIEW.PENDING_ONE: 1 student needs a decision before you continue
PREVIEW.PENDING_MANY: {{count}} students need a decision before you continue
PREVIEW.SAME_YEAR_NOTE: Every student moves to the new term in the same class and section.

TERMS.INFO: A new-year rollover is based on the grades of every term of {{year}}. Close the grades of each of its terms first, so no mark changes after the promote and repeat decisions were made from it.
TERMS.ALL_CLOSED_TITLE: Every term of the year is closed
TERMS.ALL_CLOSED_TEXT: You can continue to the confirmation.

CONFIRM.NO_TARGET_HINT: Students with no section to move to are not moved. Their names and the reason are shown after the rollover.
CONFIRM.WARNING_TEXT: The grades of every term of {{year}} will be closed for good and cannot be opened again.
CONFIRM.YEAR_LABEL: Type the year name to confirm
CONFIRM.YEAR_MISMATCH: This does not match the year name.
CONFIRM.PASSWORD_HINT: To check that you are the one running the rollover.
CONFIRM.PASSWORD_NOTE: The password is not saved and is cleared after every attempt

RESULT.TITLE: Students rolled over to {{term}}
RESULT.GRADES_CLOSED: The grades of {{year}} are now closed for good.
RESULT.NO_GRADES_CLOSED: No grades were closed in a same-year rollover.
RESULT.NOT_PLACED_HINT: Activate the missing class or section, then roll them over again from this page, or place them from the Students page.

ERROR.LOAD_FAILED: Failed to load the terms. Please try again.
